page.overview:
Who is Tim Moriarty?

Tim Moriarty is a non-canon character that made his debut and only appearance in the Mortal Kombat novel. He is one of the Black Dragon thugs that travels with Kano. He makes fun of Kano by calling him a "freakin' Cyclops".
